page.overview:
Who is Atrix?

While Atrix's political climb was a bit aggressive, he since grew to be a formidable leader. He had also been known to take personal delight in the occasional celebration, allowing himself to relax publicly. Friendly in demeanor, though strict in law, Margrave Atrix was not one to cross.

When the Chroma Conclave attacked Westruun, followed immediately by the invasion of the Herd of Storms, Margrave Atrix lost control of his city. Kevdak killed Atrix, had his head impaled on a barricade as a warning symbol, and took the Margrave's house as his own.
